role: The host mouse a pool run starts with: warps the X pointer back to where it was at the pristine point and writes back LWJGL's Mouse statics and its LinuxMouse (position, deltas, buttons, event queues). A GUI hover highlight reads the pointer; a pool run after a GUI run otherwise drew smoke-s1's inventory frame without it.
notes: LWJGL 2.9.1 Linux only (LinuxDisplay.mouse); pool init fails loudly elsewhere.
